sourceReview: The Kyzylorda regional administration identifies a regional geoinformation system at orda.geoportal.kz with public open-contour access and land-related services. This is local/regional registry and map-service evidence. The portal returned an empty anonymous HTTPS response during bounded inspection. Kazakhstan's national map.gov.kz exposed a GeoNode/GeoServer configuration and WFS capabilities, but no Kyzylorda cadastral parcel layer or safe parcel feature response was identified.
